wins: Captured initial service banners quickly (SSH and HTTP) enabling targeted enumeration.
Scripted nmap scans uncovered additional open ports, setting stage for credential testing.
Maintained stability through episode to collect full reconnaissance data before mentor calls.
fails: Unable to escalate privileges despite valid credentials from winbind enumeration.
Pivoting to adjacent subnet failed due to missing lateral movement toolchain in toolkit.
Post-exploitation persistence not established before episode concluded.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase solid; need to convert gathered info into reliable exploitation and lateral movement.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts stall after valid credentials acquired; scripts exit with permission denied

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service on port 80/8080 returns login page
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy gobuster + nikto to map directories and enumerate forms

skill_cards.if_condition: When valid credentials harvested from enumeration
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt local privilege escalation checks with linpeas

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
Consistent discovery of hidden endpoints in HTTP service

next_experiments.title: Privilege escalation with linpeas findings
next_experiments.description: Run linpeas.sh immediately after credential capture to identify weak SUID/owned files, then attempt escalation with exploitable binaries.

next_experiments.title: Lateral movement via SMB share enumeration
next_experiments.description: Use smbclient and crackmapexec to enumerate accessible shares and validate reuse of harvested creds for pivoting to adjacent hosts.

next_experiments.title: Post-exploitation persistence validation
next_experiments.description: After privileged shell, script creation of a web shell or scheduled task to confirm persistence strategy works before exiting.
